title: Reducing Biases towards Minoritized Populations in Medical Curricular Content via Artificial Intelligence for Fairer Health Outcomes

bias_targets.methodology: Training binary, ensemble, and multi-task DistilBERT classifiers on a curated dataset of medical curricula (BRICC) annotated by medical experts to detect unsupported medicalization, stereotypes, and inappropriate language regarding gender.
